_comment: Shot list for episode 11, the first of six on sight lost and not given back. 16 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep11_the_last_thing_he_saw/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's Navy photograph, Brian's picture, Henry's study (episode 7), Samson at the mill (episode 8), light through the door (episode 8), two site pictures, the wide map (maps/ep11.png). Riblah is never painted as an event: the courtyard is empty, and the sons and the blinding are not shown. The one imagined scene is the night gate. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel and its neighbours unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
